question: What should you do before eating food? 🧼
explanation: Great job! We must always wash our hands to keep the germs away! 🧼
hint: You use soap and water for this.

question: Which white drink makes your bones very strong? 🥛
explanation: Yay! Drinking milk every day makes you strong and tall! 🦸‍♂️
hint: It comes from a cow.

question: What is the morning meal called? 🌅
explanation: Awesome! We eat breakfast in the morning before going to school! 🎒
hint: You eat it after waking up.

question: What do we eat in the afternoon? ☀️
explanation: Super star! We eat a yummy lunch in the middle of the day! 🥪
hint: You bring it in your school tiffin.

question: What is the night meal called? 🌙
explanation: Yay! We eat dinner with our family at night before sleeping! 🛌
hint: It is the last meal of the day.

question: What is a long yellow fruit that monkeys love? 🍌
explanation: Great job! Monkeys and children love to eat sweet yellow bananas! 🐒
hint: You peel it before eating.

question: Which fruit is red, crunchy, and very sweet? 🍎
explanation: Awesome! Eating a fresh red apple keeps you very healthy! 🩺
hint: It keeps the doctor away.

question: What orange vegetable does a rabbit eat? 🥕
explanation: Super star! Carrots are very good for your beautiful eyes! 👀
hint: It is long, orange, and crunchy.

question: What do we do with our food inside the mouth? 👄
explanation: Yay! We must chew our food nicely so our tummy feels good! 🤰
hint: You use your teeth to do this.

question: What should you drink when you are thirsty? 💧
explanation: Great job! Drinking plenty of clean water is very healthy! 🚰
hint: It has no colour and comes from the tap.

question: What is round, flat, and made from wheat? 🫓
explanation: Awesome! Mother makes soft round rotis for lunch! 👩‍🍳
hint: You eat it with dal.

question: What yellow soup do we eat with rice? 🥣
explanation: Super star! Tasty dal is full of protein to make you strong! 💪
hint: It is also called lentils.

question: What are the small white grains we eat with dal? 🍚
explanation: Yay! Rice and dal make a very yummy meal! 😋
hint: They are small, soft, and white when cooked.

question: Where do we put food to eat it? 👄
explanation: Great job! We open our mouth wide to eat our yummy food! 😄
hint: It has your teeth and tongue inside.

question: What do we use to bite our food? 🦷
explanation: Awesome! Our strong white teeth help us bite and chew! 😁
hint: You brush them every morning.

question: What is the red, juicy vegetable we put in salads? 🍅
explanation: Super star! Red tomatoes make our salads very tasty! 🥗
hint: It is round and red.

question: What white oval food do we get from a hen? 🥚
explanation: Yay! Boiled eggs are very healthy to eat for breakfast! 🍳
hint: It has a yellow center.

question: Which sweet yellow fruit is the King of Fruits? 🥭
explanation: Great job! Sweet and juicy mangoes are very delicious! 🥭
hint: We eat it in the summer.

question: What must we do to fresh fruits before eating? 🚰
explanation: Awesome! Washing fruits removes all the dirt and germs! 🚿
hint: You use water for this.

question: What colour are healthy spinach leaves? 🥬
explanation: Super star! Eating green leafy vegetables makes you smart! 🧠
hint: It is the colour of grass.

question: Which small yellow fruit is very sour? 🍋
explanation: Yay! We squeeze sour lemon to make yummy lemonade! 🥤
hint: It makes your face go puckered.

question: Who should we sit and eat our dinner with? 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Great job! Eating meals with our family is a very happy time! ❤️
hint: It includes your mother, father, and siblings.

question: What do we use to drink water? 🥛
explanation: Awesome! We pour fresh water into a clean glass to drink! 💧
hint: It is tall and holds liquids.

question: What tool helps us eat our rice and dal? 🥄
explanation: Super star! We use a spoon nicely to eat our soft food! 🍛
hint: It has a little bowl shape at the end.

question: Which big fruit is green outside and red inside? 🍉
explanation: Yay! Watermelon has lots of sweet juice for summer days! ☀️
hint: It has little black seeds inside.

question: How should you eat your food? 🪑
explanation: Great job! Good children always sit quietly to eat their food! 🍽️
hint: You use a chair at the table.

question: What word do we say when the food is very tasty? 😋
explanation: Awesome! We smile and say 'Yummy' when mother cooks good food! 🍲
hint: It means the food is delicious.

question: Why do we need to eat healthy food? ⚡
explanation: Super star! Good food gives us energy to play and learn! 🎈
hint: It makes you run fast.

question: Eating healthy food helps us to...? 📏
explanation: Yay! Nutritious food helps your body grow tall and strong! 🦸‍♀️
hint: Your clothes get too small because you do this.

question: Which fruit shares its name with a colour? 🍊
explanation: Great job! Sweet and sour oranges are full of healthy juice! 🥤
hint: It is round and has a peel.

question: What are small green or purple fruits that grow in a bunch? 🍇
explanation: Awesome! Little grapes are very fun and sweet to eat! 🍇
hint: You can pop them in your mouth one by one.

question: How fast should you eat your meal? 🐢
explanation: Super star! Eating slowly helps your tummy digest the food! 🤰
hint: Take your time and chew.

question: What yellow food grows on a long cob with green leaves? 🌽
explanation: Yay! Sweet corn has lovely little yellow kernels to eat! 🌽
hint: We love to eat it roasted or boiled.

question: What is a healthy white food made from milk? 🥣
explanation: Great job! Curd is very cool and good for your stomach! 😋
hint: It is also called yogurt.

question: What round brown vegetable is used to make french fries? 🥔
explanation: Awesome! Potatoes are super yummy when boiled or cooked in sabzi! 🥔
hint: It grows under the soil.

question: When your tummy rumbles, it means you are...? 🤤
explanation: Super star! A rumbling tummy means it is time to eat food! 🍲
hint: You want to eat something.

question: What should you do if the food drops on the dirty floor? 🌍
explanation: Yay! We never eat food from the floor because it has germs! 🦠
hint: It is not safe to eat anymore.

question: What kind of food keeps us healthy? 🥗
explanation: Great job! Fresh food smells good and makes our bodies very happy! ✨
hint: It is cooked today or just picked from a tree.

question: What are the small round green balls in a pod? 🫛
explanation: Awesome! Green peas are sweet and fun to pop out of the pod! 🌱
hint: They look like little green beads.

question: What sweet golden syrup do bees make? 🍯
explanation: Super star! Honey is sweet, sticky, and very good for you! 🐝
hint: It comes in a jar.

question: What part of your mouth tastes the sweet and salty food? 👅
explanation: Yay! Your little tongue helps you taste all the yummy flavours! 😋
hint: You stick it out sometimes.

question: What do we serve our rice and roti on? 🍽️
explanation: Great job! We eat from a clean plate on the dining table! 🥘
hint: It is flat and round.

question: What do we use to serve hot dal? 🥣
explanation: Awesome! A deep bowl is perfect for holding yummy dal or soup! 🥣
hint: It looks like a little cup without a handle.

question: Which long green vegetable do we eat raw in salads? 🥒
explanation: Super star! Crunchy cucumbers keep us cool and healthy! 🥗
hint: You slice it into green circles.

question: What white slice do we put inside a sandwich? 🧀
explanation: Yay! Cheese is made from milk and tastes amazing! 😋
hint: Mice love to eat it too.

question: Which crunchy food has a hard shell? 🥜
explanation: Great job! Nuts like peanuts and almonds make our brain very sharp! 🧠
hint: Squirrels love to eat them.

question: What do we call a healthy mix of raw vegetables? 🥗
explanation: Awesome! A colorful salad gives us all the vitamins we need! 🥕
hint: It has tomatoes, cucumbers, and carrots.

question: What do we do with dirty hands before lunch? 🧼
explanation: Super star! Clean hands mean clean food going into our tummy! ✨
hint: Use soap and water.

question: What should we do to vegetables before cooking them? 🚿
explanation: Yay! Washing vegetables cleans off all the farm dirt! 🌱
hint: Rinse them under the tap.

question: How do you feel when you eat good and healthy food? 😊
explanation: Great job! A healthy tummy makes for a very happy smile! 😁
hint: You feel good and want to play.
